comment: Golden-set fixtures for the user-synthesis eval. Matching semantics: every keyword group is an array of terms; a group matches when ONE output fact contains ALL terms (each term may list alternatives with '|', matching is case-insensitive substring). See scripts/eval/README.md before editing.
